2.29.0: lib/utils.safeJsonParseContent: regex-reject → recursive-strip; primitives no longer pass through (return defaultValue)
2.29.2: lib/utils.safeJsonParseContent + lib/workspace.safeParseJson + lib/commands/team-connection.safeParseJson all delegate to flow-io.safeJsonParseStringStrip; recursive scrub semantics consolidated
2.30.4: scripts/hooks/core/deferral-gate.js: checkBashGate rewritten. Prior version over-triggered on commands that merely REFERENCED the target file and the word 'deferred' as text content (markdown blockquotes inside heredoc release notes, commit messages, etc.). New version: (1) strips quoted/heredoc content before structural shell-redirect check, (2) tightens mutation patterns to require target file as WRITE DESTINATION not just mention, (3) tests against BOTH stripped and original command. wf-4a5b7a6f.
2.30.3: scripts/flow-deferral-classifier-ai.js (NEW): AI/Haiku-based deferral-intent classifier replaces regex. Closes the 'fix all' miss + handles unbounded English phrasings the regex couldn't. wf-b8839d99.

scripts/hooks/core/deferral-classifier.js: refactored to thin async wrapper around the AI classifier. Regex patterns deleted entirely (per user instruction 2026-05-11: 'I don't want regex or matching when I answer things like that').

scripts/hooks/core/deferral-gate.js: marker shape v2 — separates AI's interpretation (`source`) from verbatim user excerpt (`userPromptExcerpt`). Adds `grantedBy`, `confidence`, `standing` fields. Standing pins get 7-day TTL.
scripts/flow-defer-auth.js: `grant` subcommand refuses non-TTY invocation. AI subprocesses can no longer self-issue deferral authorization. Override: --i-am-human.
scripts/hooks/core/no-defer-policy.js (NEW): SessionStart reads decisions.md for an explicit no-defer policy section; refreshes pin with 30-day TTL if found.

scripts/hooks/entry/claude-code/stop.js: routing-recovery grace window — when the AI classifier detects a NEGATIVE correction after a prior auth marker, routing-enforcement softens for 60s so the AI can act on the correction without re-routing.
2.30.2: scripts/hooks/core/research-required-classifier.js: bare /\brecommend\b/ replaced with anchored pattern (requires sentence-start). Mid-clause 'recommend' no longer triggers the diagnostic gate. wf-12271e82.
scripts/hooks/core/long-input-enforcement.js: isSystemOriginatedContent() exempts <task-notification>, <system-reminder>, and other tool-result echoes from the long-input gate. wf-f7d58760.
scripts/flow-phase.js: transition CLI now writes workflow-phase.json regardless of phaseGate.enabled. Previously silent no-op when gate was off. wf-88a08fd4.

scripts/hooks/core/gate-orchestrator.js: NEW. Priority-orders competing remediations across UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks; only the top-priority gate surfaces its message, others queue. wf-35742353.
scripts/hooks/core/task-gate.js: documented 4-source 'active task' contract in header; exported writeRoutingReceipt() for external tooling. wf-c573961f.
scripts/flow-standards-gate.js: runTaskStandardsCheck tolerates string[] file lists (was crashing with undefined.includes on every flow done). wf-6c9ed721.
lib/installer.js: scaffolds .workflow/state/forbidden-patterns.json from template on fresh installs (closes H2 from v2.30.0 review). wf-d5fcb880.
